scene: The humming brass bird drops three route tickets into your palm.
picture: A flat side-view concourse with three transit gates along the platform floor. On the far left, a carved koi-shaped boat waits at a canal mooring. In the centre, the grandfather holds tickets beside his plant crate bicycle next to an open ivy-wrapped tram. On the far right stands a gleaming crimson retro streetcar.
